race.comment: CUBAN CIGAR (3) never on the track with a tenacious third from back in the field over 1600m at Warwick Farm in BM72 class. Gets a similar set-up again and will appreciate the fast tempo. JACENZA (8) tough gelding holding his form. Stripped fitter and appreciated the extra ground when he led throughout for a comfortable victory over 1500m at Newcastle. Has options from the draw  and looks up to this stronger contest. RESET THE JAZZ (1) proven miler who looks well placed for this. Was a month between runs with a game on pace third over this trip at Mornington. Proven in stronger company and is adept in all conditions. Hard to hold out. TAINUI (5) will relish the class drop and has a solid record here.
